storylines: Houston enters year 2 for Head Coach Chris Walters while Caledonia enters its first season under Michael Campbell
The Hilltoppers finished 2025 with a record of 3-9 and the Cavaliers finished 1-9 in Michael Kelly's final season at Caledonia
While this is a scrimmage game, Houston leads official head to head against Caledonia with a record of 16-2.  The last time they met was November 1st 2024
This is CSRN's first broadcast in this format!   This will be a 2 quarter scrimmage.
